```{r}
# --- Libraries ---
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(gstat)
library(randomForest)
library(purrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# --- Load & Merge Data ---
covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")
soil_SP <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP.csv")
soil_C  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C.csv")

soil_CN <- read_csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/carbon/soil_data_with_CN.csv") %>%
  rename(c = leco_carbon_average, n = leco_nitrogen_average)

SP_CN <- soil_CN %>% filter(type == "SPID")
C_CN  <- soil_CN %>% filter(type == "CID")

soil_SP_full <- soil_SP %>% left_join(SP_CN %>% select(x, y, c, n), by = c("x", "y"))
soil_C_full  <- soil_C  %>% left_join(C_CN  %>% select(x, y, c, n), by = c("x", "y"))

soil_vars <- c("p_h_2", "ca", "k", "mg", "mn", "p", "zn", "c", "n")
covariates <- setdiff(names(soil_SP_full), c("x", "y", soil_vars))

# Add PointLabel before converting to sf
soil_SP_full <- soil_SP_full %>%
  left_join(SP_CN %>% select(x, y, PointLabel), by = c("x", "y"))
soil_C_full <- soil_C_full %>%
  left_join(C_CN %>% select(x, y, PointLabel), by = c("x", "y"))

soil_sf_SP <- st_as_sf(soil_SP_full, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)
soil_sf_C  <- st_as_sf(soil_C_full,  coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>% st_transform(32617)

# --- Random Bootstrap Split Function ---
generate_random_bootstrap <- function(sf_data, n_boot = 50, train_frac = 0.7, seed = 123){
  set.seed(seed)
  replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(sf_data)), size = ceiling(nrow(sf_data)*train_frac))
    sf_data %>% mutate(set = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(sf_data)) %in% idx, "train", "test"))
  }, simplify = FALSE)
}

# --- Modeling Functions ---
run_RF <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars){
  map(soil_vars, function(v){
    map(boot_list, function(df){
      train <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set == "train")) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates, v))) %>% na.omit()
      test  <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set == "test"))  %>% select(all_of(c(covariates, v))) %>% na.omit()
      if(nrow(train)<5 || nrow(test)<5) return(list(RMSE=NA,R2=NA))
      m <- randomForest(x=train[,covariates], y=train[[v]], ntree=500)
      p <- predict(m, newdata=test[,covariates])
      list(RMSE=sqrt(mean((p-test[[v]])^2)), R2=cor(p, test[[v]])^2)
    })
  }) |> setNames(soil_vars)
}

run_OK_boot_safe <- function(boot_list, soil_vars){
  map(soil_vars, function(v){
    map(boot_list, function(df){
      train_sf <- df %>% filter(set == "train") %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]))
      test_sf  <- df %>% filter(set == "test")  %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]))
      if(nrow(train_sf) < 5 || nrow(test_sf) < 5) return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))

      v_emp <- tryCatch(variogram(reformulate("1", v), train_sf), error = function(e) NULL)
      if(is.null(v_emp) || nrow(v_emp) == 0) return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))

      v_mod <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(v_emp, vgm(model = "Exp")), error = function(e) NULL)
      if(is.null(v_mod)) return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))

      ok <- tryCatch(krige(reformulate("1", v), train_sf, test_sf, model = v_mod), error = function(e) NULL)
      if(is.null(ok) || !"var1.pred" %in% names(ok)) return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))

      pred <- as.numeric(ok$var1.pred)
      obs  <- st_drop_geometry(test_sf)[[v]]

      n <- min(length(pred), length(obs))
      if(n < 2) return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))

      pred <- pred[seq_len(n)]
      obs  <- obs [seq_len(n)]

      list(RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), R2 = cor(pred, obs)^2)
    })
  }) |> setNames(soil_vars)
}

run_RK <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars){
  map(soil_vars, function(v){
    map(boot_list, function(df){
      tr <- df %>% filter(set=="train"); te <- df %>% filter(set=="test")
      tr_df <- st_drop_geometry(tr) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,v))) %>% na.omit()
      te_df <- st_drop_geometry(te) %>% select(all_of(c(covariates,v))) %>% na.omit()
      if(nrow(tr_df)<5 || nrow(te_df)<5) return(list(RMSE=NA,R2=NA))

      rf <- randomForest(x = tr_df[, covariates], y = tr_df[[v]], ntree = 500)
      trend_te <- predict(rf, te_df[, covariates])
      resid_tr <- tr_df[[v]] - predict(rf, tr_df[, covariates])
      tr$resid <- NA
      tr$resid[which(!is.na(st_drop_geometry(tr[[v]])))] <- resid_tr

      vg <- tryCatch(fit.variogram(variogram(resid ~ 1, tr), vgm(model = "Exp")), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(vg)) return(list(RMSE = NA, R2 = NA))

      kr <- tryCatch(krige(resid ~ 1, tr, te, model = vg)$var1.pred, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(kr)) return(list(RMSE = NA, R2 = NA))

      valid_idx <- which(!is.na(te_df[[v]]))
      final <- trend_te + kr[valid_idx]

      if (length(final) != length(te_df[[v]])) return(list(RMSE = NA, R2 = NA))
      list(
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((final - te_df[[v]])^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        R2   = cor(final, te_df[[v]])^2
      )
    })
  }) |> setNames(soil_vars)
}

# --- Run Models (Random Split) ---
boot_SP <- generate_random_bootstrap(soil_sf_SP)
boot_C  <- generate_random_bootstrap(soil_sf_C)

RF_SP <- run_RF(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RF_C  <- run_RF(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)
OK_SP <- run_OK_boot_safe(boot_SP, soil_vars)
OK_C  <- run_OK_boot_safe(boot_C,  soil_vars)
RK_SP <- run_RK(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RK_C  <- run_RK(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)

# --- Combine metrics ---
extract_metrics <- function(res_list, dataset_name){
  map_dfr(names(res_list), function(v){
    tibble(variable = v,
           RMSE = map_dbl(res_list[[v]], "RMSE"),
           R2   = map_dbl(res_list[[v]], "R2"),
           dataset = dataset_name)
  })
}

metrics_RF <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RF_SP, "Single Point"), extract_metrics(RF_C, "Composite")) %>% mutate(method = "RF")
metrics_OK <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(OK_SP, "Single Point"), extract_metrics(OK_C, "Composite")) %>% mutate(method = "OK")
metrics_RK <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RK_SP, "Single Point"), extract_metrics(RK_C, "Composite")) %>% mutate(method = "RK")

combined_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_RF, metrics_OK, metrics_RK) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(RMSE, R2), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

# --- Plot: Violin Plots for RMSE and R² ---
method_colors <- c(RF = "#92D050", OK = "#0F9ED5", RK = "#884E71")

filtered_metrics_RMSE <- combined_metrics %>%
  filter(metric == "RMSE", !variable %in% c("lbc_1", "lb_ceq")) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, "p_h_2"="pH","ca"="Ca","k"="K","mg"="Mg",
                      "mn"="Mn","p"="P","zn"="Zn","c"="C","n"="N"),
    method   = factor(method, levels = c("OK","RF","RK")),
    dataset  = factor(dataset, levels = c("Single Point","Composite"))
  )

filtered_metrics_R2 <- combined_metrics %>%
  filter(metric == "R2", !variable %in% c("lbc_1", "lb_ceq")) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, "p_h_2"="pH","ca"="Ca","k"="K","mg"="Mg",
                      "mn"="Mn","p"="P","zn"="Zn","c"="C","n"="N"),
    method   = factor(method, levels = c("OK","RF","RK")),
    dataset  = factor(dataset, levels = c("Single Point","Composite"))
  )

make_violin_plot <- function(df, ylab, title){
  ggplot(df, aes(x = dataset, y = value)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = method),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                width = 0.8, trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = method, group = interaction(dataset, method)),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                 width = 0.14, outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, size = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(aes(color = method),
                 fun = mean, geom = "point",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                 size = 2.5, shape = 18) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Dataset", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

p_rmse <- make_violin_plot(filtered_metrics_RMSE, "RMSE",
                           "RMSE by Nutrient, Method, and Dataset")
p_r2   <- make_violin_plot(filtered_metrics_R2, "R²",
                           "R² by Nutrient, Method, and Dataset")

p_rmse
p_r2
```
